_comment: Winnebago Industries, FY2024 (year ended 31 August 2024), from their 10-K income
tax footnote. Public disclosure only — no taxpayer data. Amounts in whole dollars.
Their reconciliation runs 21.0% statutory to 66.2% effective. Each rate line grossed
up at 21% against pretax income of $38.37M ($25.4M provision / 66.2%) gives the
tax-free and dividend income         -1.1%  ->   $2.01M, entered as the §103
after credits $20,562,000. That reconciles to their federal provision of $22.18M
($25.40M total less $3.22M state) once the valuation allowance (+$1.92M), uncertain
tax positions (-$0.65M) and other (+$0.35M) are added back — all three are ASC 740
recognition constructs with no place on a return.
